title: GPT-4.1 Nano joins the anonymous tier
summary:
GPT-4.1 Nano moved into the anonymous tier, the model listing got a cleanup, and the community showcase gained an image tool.

The model catalog now assigns `openai-fast` (GPT-4.1 Nano) to the anonymous tier.

The Creative Projects list added a community tool for generating celebrity images from text and making celebrity selfies from uploaded photos.

GET /models now puts non-community models before community models and sorts each group by name. Pricing fields were removed from that response, while text-generation telemetry now retains complete usage data, including cached-token counts.

daily.title: GPT-4.1 Nano, anonymously
daily.text: The model catalog now puts `openai-fast` (GPT-4.1 Nano) in the anonymous tier. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).
